title: The rpg gate reruns only the rows main's latest report does not carry and writes a new-vs-main diff
summary: rpg_gate_report skips the rerun for fail/drift rows whose key and state are in main's latest completed gate report (fetched by the new rpg_gate_main_report), falls back to the full rerun on any doubt, and writes vs_main to the summary, JSON and log; workflow gains actions: read; replay test over trimmed recorded reports. AC9 split to a post-merge check on #631.
